title: Please Hold For Your Diagnosis
preview: Pharmacy paperwork, a cheerful robot, and an EHR with strong opinions.

jokes.setup: My insurer says my new medication requires step therapy.
jokes.punchline: Step one is the drug that already failed, step two is a form, and step three is me failing the form.

jokes.setup: Our EHR just added an AI feature that suggests the next best action for every patient.
jokes.punchline: It's always the same: a pop-up asking whether I'd like to document that I considered it.

cartoon.caption: “Your prescription is ready. The paperwork for your prescription will be ready in March.”
cartoon.alt: A weary pharmacist hands a bearded patient a tiny paper bag beside a towering stack of forms while a cheerful robot holds a clipboard.
